# fct_provider_api_rate_requests

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_provider_api_rate_requests` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for API request/response events with error monitoring and retry analysis. Each row represents a single provider API attempt (including retries) with error categorization. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `provider_api_rate_request_id` | Primary Key. Concatenation of raw log ID and rate_requested_at timestamp to ensure uniqueness across all attempts. Each retry attempt has a unique provider_api_rate_request_id. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `action` | API action type for the provider request (e.g. 'hotel_availability_single'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | UUID of the advisor who initiated the provider request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `attempt_number` | Sequential attempt number for this trace ID (1 = first attempt, 2 = first retry, etc.). Used to identify retry attempts. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_in_date` | Check-in date for the hotel availability request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_out_date` | Check-out date for the hotel availability request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_provider_request_attempts` | Total number of attempts made for the raw_provider_request_log_id (1 = no retries, 2+ = had retries). Use to analyze retry patterns and identify requests requiring multiple attempts. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `error_category` | Detailed error categorization based on fault message patterns. Only populated when there is an error detected. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `error_type` | High-level error type grouping for simplified analysis. This is the source of truth for all error detection across multiple response formats (SOAP XML, JSON, HTTP codes). 'user error' (advisor input issues like invalid dates or capacity); 'hotel error' (hotel responsibility like no availability loaded); 'hotel or provider error' (ambiguous - could be either party's fault); 'Fora or Provider error' (configuration issue); 'unknown' (unrecognized SOAP fault); NULL (no error detected) >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_soap_fault` | True/false flag indicating if response contains a SOAP fault (XML error structure with <soap:fault> tag). True when is_complete = true AND response_code = 200 AND response body contains '<soap:fault>'. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_complete` | True/false flag indicating if the provider request completed execution. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_final_attempt` | True/false flag indicating if this is the final/most recent attempt for a provider_api_rate_request_id. True for the last attempt in a retry sequence. Use to filter to one row per user request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `provider` | Provider/GDS name for the API request (e.g. 'travelport'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_requested_at` | Timestamp when the provider request was made. Partition key for the table. Used to identify timing and sequence of retry attempts. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `raw_provider_request_log_id` | Trace ID grouping retry attempts together. Same ID indicates retries of the same user request. Multiple rows can share the same ID if the request was retried. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_body` | Payload of the provider API. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_id` | Foreign Key. Request identifier linking to fct_booking_platform_rates. Used to join provider request logs with booking platform rate results. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_method` | HTTP request method used for the provider API call. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_url` | Full URL of the provider API endpoint that was called. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `response_body` | Text/details from the provider API response. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `response_code` | HTTP response status code from the provider API. 200 = successful API call (may still have an error). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the supplier. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `user_email` | Email address of the user (advisor) who initiated the provider request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
